_comment: ウォーターフォールクエストの ドット絵（2026-10-20 tomy さんの 指定「もっと リッチな ドット絵の RPG 風に」）。生成は scripts/slides/gen_images.mjs と 同じ 手順（bridge 経由）で、場面ごとの refs を 使う。できた 絵は `node scripts/images/place_quest_pixel.mjs <PNG の フォルダ>` で 本物の ドット絵の 粗さに 直して public/img/quest/ に 置く。相手役は 2026-10-21 の 指定「元の 絵に 忠実に なりすぎず、名前に 相応しい 絵に」で、旧アプリの 場面ごとの 絵を 見本に 渡すのを やめ、人物の 姿だけを 渡して 表情・ポーズ・小物は 名前から 決めた（場面1・2・4・13 は その 前に 作った 絵で、名前に 合って いるので 残した）。
style: 16-bit Japanese console RPG PIXEL ART, like a 1990s Super Famicom role-playing game. The whole picture is drawn on a strict square pixel grid: it is a small low-resolution image enlarged with nearest-neighbour scaling, so every art pixel is a crisp, hard-edged square block of exactly the same size. No anti-aliasing, no blur, no smooth gradients (shading only with flat colour steps and a little ordered dithering), no painterly brush texture, no photographic detail. Limited palette of about 32 colours with clear 1-pixel dark outlines on characters and objects. Bright, warm, friendly and kid-safe: a cheerful office-work RPG about building a software app, never a dark fantasy.
noText: No text, no letters, no kanji, no kana, no numbers anywhere in the image. Screens, papers, whiteboards and signs are blank or show only simple pictures. No watermark, no signature, no speech balloons.
negative: Never: smooth vector illustration, 3D render, painterly or blurry rendering, anti-aliased edges, real company logos or brand marks, national flags, country outlines, maps with borders, scary or violent mood, weapons, blood.

scenes.title: ネクマックス ENFP
scenes.scene:
Character: "NexMax", the official robot mascot of NEXT MAKE.
Anatomy (must match the reference images exactly):
- Rounded helmet-like head, wider than tall, with two small rounded ear pods on the sides of the head and a small antenna ball on top.
- Large white rounded face-screen covering most of the face.
- Two black oval eyes and a small gentle smile on the white screen.
- Small trapezoid torso with the NEXT MAKE chest mark: a navy (#004F8D) double-peak "M" logo (two triangular mountain shapes).
- Segmented ball-joint arms with round elbows and mitten hands.
- Short segmented legs with rounded boots.
Mood: friendly, curious, encouraging. Kid-safe.
THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: this is the player's own NexMax as a small pixel-art RPG party member. Redraw the robot in the SECOND reference image (its colour and props) with the body shape of the FIRST reference image, as a chibi pixel-art sprite in three-quarter view turned slightly to the LEFT: bright PINK body colour, holding a small bunch of pink balloons in one hand, the other arm open in a happy gesture. Use the THIRD reference image only for the pixel-art style and palette, not for its content.
scenes.output: Output: one SQUARE pixel-art sprite, 1024x1024. Draw it at 64x64 art pixels and enlarge it exactly 16x, so each art pixel is a 16x16 block. The whole background is ONE flat solid pure magenta colour (#FF00FF) with nothing else on it (it will be keyed out to transparent). One character only, full body, centred, filling about 85% of the height, no floor, no shadow.
